en.headline: Mainland visitor wounded in Mong Kok early-morning attack
en.dek: A 35-year-old man was injured in the neck at a building on Argyle Street around 2 am; police classify the case as wounding and are seeking a suspect.
body: Police are investigating a wounding case in which a 35-year-old mainland Chinese visitor was injured in the neck early on 29 July inside a building on Argyle Street in Mong Kok.

The incident occurred around 2 am. The man later reached street level and sought help; he was conscious when taken to hospital. Officers took three Thai women from the building to assist with inquiries. No arrests have been made.

The case has been classified as wounding and is being handled by the Mong Kok district crime investigation team. Police are seeking a suspect described as a long-haired person wearing a white skirt at the time of the incident.
Investigators are examining the circumstances of a reported dispute that preceded the attack.

zh.headline: 旺角凌晨傷人案內地男頸部受傷
zh.dek: 35歲男子約凌晨2時在亞皆老街大廈內頸部受傷，清醒送院；警方列傷人案調查，正通緝一名疑犯。
body: 警方正調查一宗傷人案。一名35歲內地男訪客於7月29日凌晨在旺角亞皆老街一幢大廈內頸部受傷。
事發約凌晨2時。事主其後到達地面求助，送院時清醒。警方從大廈帶走三名泰國籍女子協助調查，暫時無人被捕。
案件列作傷人，由旺角分區刑事調查隊跟進。警方正追尋一名案發時蓄長髮、穿白色裙的疑犯。
調查人員正了解事發前據報的爭執情況。
